newsitem.title: JAPAN: Unisia Jecs says to build unit's plant in Georgia.
newsitem.headline: Unisia Jecs says to build unit's plant in Georgia.

text.p: Car parts maker Unisia Jecs Corp said on Tuesday that it had decided to build a factory for its newly formed unit in the U.S. state of Georgia.
Total investment in the Unisia of Georgia Corp plant will be $40 million, a company spokesman said.
The unit is wholly owned by Unisia Jecs, he said.
Unisia Jecs is about 30 percent owned by Nissan Motor Co Ltd.

Unisia of Georgia will start production in January 1999 and initially sell products to Nissan units and a joint venture between Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd and Isuzu Motors Ltd in the United States, he said.
Unisia Jecs hopes to sell the unit's products to U.S. and European car makers in the future as well, he said.
Sales at the unit is expected at $15.5 million in 1999, rising to $60 million in 2005, he said.
It will hire 86 employees in 1999, rising to 106 in 2005, the spokesman said.
